mechanics.claim: Yone's basic attacks alternate between physical-only (Steel) and mixed physical/magic (azakana) hits; there is no time-out to this alternation and it persists through death.
mechanics.quote: '''Yone's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Steel Sword|Steel}} and {{as|Azakana Sword|azakana}} {{tip|on-attack}}

mechanics.claim: The azakana attack's mixed damage is dealt as two simultaneous damage instances, but behaves as a single instance for most effects such as Conqueror stacks.
mechanics.quote: The mixed damage is dealt in two simultaneous instances of damage, but will pretend to be a single instance for most effects (such as {{ris|Conqueror}} stacks).

mechanics.claim: Both azakana damage instances deal basic damage and thus both natively apply life steal.
mechanics.quote: Both instances deal {{tip|basic damage}} and thus natively apply {{sti|life steal}}.

mechanics.claim: On-hit effects from the azakana attack are applied only once, at the start of the attack.
mechanics.quote: The attack applies [[on-hit]] effects only once, right at the start.

mechanics.claim: Even if the target dies from the magic damage portion, the physical damage portion still applies to it (unless the target died from on-hit damage, in which case the magic portion is skipped).
mechanics.quote: Even if the target dies from the {{as|magic damage}}, the {{as|physical damage}} will still be applied to it.

mechanics.claim: Yone requires at least 50% critical strike chance to reach 100% critical strike chance from the passive's doubling multiplier.
mechanics.quote: '''Yone''' requires at least {{sti|{{as|50% critical strike chance}}}} in order to reach {{as|100% critical strike chance}} from ''Way of the Hunter's'' multiplier.

mechanics.claim: Half of Spellblade and Demolish damage is converted to magic damage if applied by the azakana sword attack.
mechanics.quote: 50% of {{tip|Spellblade}} and {{ri|Demolish}} damage will be converted to {{as|magic damage}} if applied by the {{as|Azakana Sword|azakana}}.
